India finishes 8th in FIH Pro League, coach optimistic

The Indian men's hockey team concluded the FIH Pro League season in eighth place out of nine teams, securing 19 points from 16 matches. Despite the ranking, coach Graham Reid expressed confidence in the team's ability to defeat any opponent, looking ahead to upcoming challenges like the World Cup and Asian Games.
